title: game.json - the manifest of a standard 3D first-person game

id.description: short key; also the storage key prefix and the GA4 game name

version.description: semver of the game; equals the newest release-notes entry

standard.description: the game-kit standard it was built on, e.g. 1.0

theme.description: data-theme value (a LIST of words): a base dark-industrial | paper-light | retro-crt, a mood theme of css/themes.css (shrine-night, summer-rural, hospital-cold, school-dusk, vhs-tape, snow-silence, deep-water, blood-washi, office-night, candle-room, fog-forest, pencil-diary), and/or the game's own

preset.description: render-presets preset: horror | dusk | office | zoo ... Or { base, ...overrides } (extendPreset; colours as numbers).

modules.description: kit modules the game uses (kit.json modules is derived from it)

titleImage.description: title screen background image (relative to the game root)

controls.description: fov, near, far, eye, step (the default footstep surface, js/step-sound.js: wood tatami gravel snow ...), touch: [{ k: key code, label, id?, cls? }] (the on-screen buttons of the touch UI)

renderWhileBooting.description: true = the 3D view is drawn every frame while the boot steps run (default: not drawn until booted)

quality.description: false = no quality tier (default: a tier is chosen once from the device)

fx.description: screen effects (js/fx-std.js): a preset name (old-tv | clean | horror | retro-crt) or { preset, noise, scanlines, vignette, saturation, glitch, dangerTint, mist, exposure }

voice.description: true = ctx.playVoice(src, 'phone' | 'pa' | 'radio' | 'wall') is available (js/voice-fx.js, rule S15)

recipes.description: content recipes switched on: props (plan.furniture kinds), openables, textures (folder of the catalog), ambience { beds } (js/recipes.js)

minigames.description: extra mini game types registered by js/ext (not kit task-minigames types)

ext.description: game-specific extension modules, loaded in order; each default-exports (ext, ctx) => void

themeColors.description: standard 1.9: a theme made from a few colours (js/theme-make.js makeTheme, every pair AA-fitted), put on top of theme. from: a mood theme to start from

spotFx.description: standard 1.9: the default 'it saw you' effect for every monster (js/spot-fx.js; monsters.json spotFx wins)

music.description: standard 1.9: title music, played after the first click / key on the title and faded out at the start (stage music: stages.json levels[].look.music)

stationsWhenDone.description: standard 1.9: 'hide' takes a station out of the interactables once all its tasks are done (js/stage-look.js)
